jp: 先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}質問[しつもん]{を|o-object}し{に|ni-purpose}職員室[しょくいんしつ]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]きました。
en: I went to the staff room to ask the teacher a question.
why: The verb stem し plus に states why I went: to ask a question.

jp: 午後[ごご]、コピー{を|o-object}し{に|ni-purpose}事務室[じむしつ]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]ってきます。
en: This afternoon I'm going to the office to make copies.
why: The stem し plus に gives the purpose of going: to make copies.

jp: 来週[らいしゅう]{の|no-possessive}火曜日[かようび]、試験[しけん]{を|o-object}受[う]け{に|ni-purpose}大学[だいがく]{に/へ|ni-destination}来[き]てください。
en: Please come to the university next Tuesday to take the exam.
why: The stem 受け plus に states the purpose of coming: to take the exam.

jp: 山田[やまだ]さん{は|wa-topic}会議[かいぎ]{に|ni-purpose}行[い]っています。
en: Mr. Yamada has gone to a meeting.
why: An event noun like 会議 plus に gives the purpose of going: to attend it.

jp: 友[とも]だち{と|to-with}宿題[しゅくだい]{を|o-object}し{に|ni-purpose}図書館[としょかん]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]きます。
en: I'm going to the library with a friend to do homework.
why: し plus に says the purpose of going: to do homework.

jp: 先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}ノート{を|o-object}見[み]せ{に|ni-purpose}行[い]きました。
en: I went to show my notebook to the teacher.
why: The stem 見せ plus に gives the purpose of going: to show the notebook.

jp: 週末[しゅうまつ]、アルバイト{に|ni-purpose}行[い]きます。
en: On weekends I go to my part-time job.
why: A work activity such as アルバイト plus に gives the purpose of going.

jp: 授業[じゅぎょう]{の|no-possessive}あと、先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}聞[き]き{に|ni-purpose}行[い]きましょう。
en: After class, let's go and ask the teacher.
why: The stem 聞き plus に states the purpose of going: to ask.
